import sys
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace
import torch

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "stage2_RQ-VAE" / "TIGER_c117_global_sinkhorn_poincare"
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
from model.hyperbolic import project_ball, squared_distance, squared_distance_matrix
from model.model import RQVAE

class GeometryGradientTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_curved_gradcheck_and_finite_difference(self):
        x = torch.tensor([[0.13, -0.21], [0.31, 0.08]], dtype=torch.double, requires_grad=True)
        y = torch.tensor([[-0.17, 0.19], [0.04, -0.26]], dtype=torch.double, requires_grad=True)
        fn = lambda a, b: squared_distance(a, b, c=1.0).sum()
        self.assertTrue(torch.autograd.gradcheck(fn, (x, y), eps=1e-6, atol=2e-5, rtol=2e-4))
        gx, gy = torch.autograd.grad(fn(x, y), (x, y))
        self.assertGreater(gx.norm().item(), 1e-6)
        self.assertGreater(gy.norm().item(), 1e-6)
        h = 1e-6
        with torch.no_grad():
            xp, xm = x.detach().clone(), x.detach().clone()
            xp[0, 0] += h; xm[0, 0] -= h
            numeric = (fn(xp, y.detach()) - fn(xm, y.detach())).item() / (2*h)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(gx[0, 0].item(), numeric, delta=2e-5)

    def test_flat_limit_projection_matrix_and_nan_negative(self):
        x = torch.tensor([[0.2, -0.3]], dtype=torch.double, requires_grad=True)
        y = torch.tensor([[-0.1, 0.15]], dtype=torch.double, requires_grad=True)
        d = squared_distance(x, y, c=0.0)
        self.assertTrue(torch.allclose(d, 4*((x-y)**2).sum(-1)))
        gx, gy = torch.autograd.grad(d.sum(), (x, y))
        self.assertGreater(gx.norm().item(), 0.0)
        self.assertTrue(torch.allclose(gx, -gy))
        p = project_ball(torch.tensor([[2., 0.], [.2, -.1]], requires_grad=True), .9)
        self.assertTrue(torch.all(torch.linalg.vector_norm(p, dim=-1) <= .900001))
        self.assertTrue(torch.allclose(squared_distance_matrix(p, p), squared_distance(p[:, None], p[None, :])))
        bad = squared_distance(torch.tensor([float("nan"), 0.]), torch.zeros(2))
        self.assertFalse(torch.isfinite(bad).all().item())

class ModelGradientTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def make_model(self):
        torch.manual_seed(17)
        cfg = SimpleNamespace(hidden_sizes=(), dropout=0., codebook_num=3,
                              codebook_size=(4,4,4), codebook_dim=3, curvature=1., radius=.9)
        model = RQVAE(cfg, in_dim=3).double()
        with torch.no_grad():
            for level, book in enumerate(model.rq.codebooks):
                book.copy_(torch.randn_like(book)*.18 + level*.025)
        return model

    def test_reconstruction_assignment_balance_gradients(self):
        m = self.make_model()
        x = torch.tensor([[.2,.1,-.4],[-.3,.5,.2],[.7,-.2,.1],[-.1,-.6,.4]], dtype=torch.double)
        m.frozen_codes = torch.tensor([[0,1,2],[1,2,0],[2,0,1],[3,1,3]])
        m.frozen_transport = torch.softmax(torch.randn(4,3,4,dtype=torch.double), -1).detach()
        bal = m.population_balance(x)
        total, rec, assign, _, _ = m(x)
        self.assertTrue(torch.isfinite(total).item())
        self.assertGreater(rec.item(), 0.); self.assertGreater(assign.item(), 0.); self.assertGreater(bal.item(), 0.)
        params = dict(m.named_parameters())
        grads = torch.autograd.grad(total+bal, tuple(params.values()), allow_unused=True)
        got = dict(zip(params, grads))
        g = got["encoder.mlp.0.weight"]
        self.assertIsNotNone(g); self.assertTrue(torch.isfinite(g).all().item()); self.assertGreater(g.norm().item(), 1e-8)
        for level in range(3):
            g = got[f"rq.codebooks.{level}"]
            self.assertIsNotNone(g); self.assertTrue(torch.isfinite(g).all().item()); self.assertGreater(g.norm().item(), 1e-8)
        self.assertFalse(m.frozen_transport.requires_grad)

    def test_transition_gradients_reach_successor_and_third_code(self):
        m = self.make_model()
        x = torch.tensor([[.1,.4,-.2],[-.5,.2,.3]], dtype=torch.double)
        m.frozen_codes = torch.tensor([[0,1,2],[2,0,1]])
        m.frozen_transport = torch.full((2,3,4), .25, dtype=torch.double)
        successor = torch.tensor([[.6,-.3,.2],[-.2,.7,-.1]], dtype=torch.double)
        r = torch.tensor([[.1,.2,.3,.4],[.4,.3,.2,.1]], dtype=torch.double)
        _, _, _, _, loss = m(x, edges=(successor, r))
        self.assertTrue(torch.isfinite(loss).item()); self.assertGreater(loss.item(), 0.)
        grads = torch.autograd.grad(loss, (m.encoder.mlp[0].weight, m.rq.codebooks[2]), allow_unused=True)
        for g in grads:
            self.assertIsNotNone(g); self.assertTrue(torch.isfinite(g).all().item()); self.assertGreater(g.norm().item(), 1e-8)

    def test_graph_disconnection_negative(self):
        p = torch.nn.Parameter(torch.tensor([1.]))
        disconnected = p.detach().square().sum()
        self.assertFalse(disconnected.requires_grad)
        self.assertIsNone(torch.autograd.grad(disconnected, p, allow_unused=True)[0] if disconnected.requires_grad else None)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
